newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atok raises par value to one peso per share.
newsitem.headline: Atok raises par value to one peso per share.

text.p: Mining firm Atok Big Wedge Co said on Tuesday its board had approved a plan to increase the par value of its shares to one peso each from the present one centavo.
Atok shares have been on the upsurge since the start of the year. It had risen to 4.8 pesos by midsession on Tuesday from a just 41 centavos on January 2.
Brokers said the stock had surged on speculation it was planning to convert to a holding firm.
In the past few months, several dormant Manila firms have turned into holding companies and ventured into the booming property business.
